Body.Content:
What and why: 
Policy-based app removal now supports multi-session environments. Use it to manage the removal of supported in-box apps on devices running Windows 11 Enterprise and Education, version 24H2 and later. This capability applies to preinstalled Microsoft Store apps and other MSIX/APPX-packaged apps.  
 
Rollout schedule: 
  • October 2025: The policy "Remove default Microsoft Store packages from the system" became available. 
  • April 2026: The policy began including a dynamic app removal list. 
  • October 2026: The policy is available for use in multi-session environments. 
 
Impact on your organization: 
This change is helpful if your organization runs Windows 11, versions 26H2, 25H2, or 24H2 Enterprise and Education editions in multi-session environments. It helps provide fewer unwanted apps, simpler provisioning, and a more tailored desktop for your users.  
 
Action required/recommendations: 
Just use a standard, policy-based approach to remove select apps, using Microsoft Intune integrated with Group Policy. Learn more in: 
  • Policy-based in-box app removal documentation 
  • Dynamically remove apps from managed Windows 11 devices 
  • Policy-based removal of pre-installed Microsoft Store apps 
 
Compliance considerations: 
No compliance considerations are identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Policy-based in-box app removal extended to multi-session environments
